instruction: Change the current GTK theme to use its dark variant by modifying the GNOME theme settings to Adwaita-dark.

metadata.explanation: Variation 5: Switches to built-in dark theme variant instead of downloading external theme. Checks gtk-theme setting via gsettings for 'Adwaita-dark' string. Simpler than original (no download needed). No custom functions needed as check_list metric is reused.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly extracts GTK theme state using 'gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.interface gtk-theme' command
The check_list metric with regex pattern 'Adwaita-dark' correctly verifies the expected theme name in the output
Complete coverage: instruction requires changing theme to Adwaita-dark, evaluator checks exactly that requirement
Practical feasibility: gsettings command will return output like 'Adwaita-dark' (with quotes), and regex search will correctly match the pattern
Expected value 'Adwaita-dark' semantically matches what the instruction specifies
